item.title: Kill Goofy — Sun Oct 11, 1:30 PM — Grove Street Theater
item.description:
Apricot Sky Productions’s new play, Kill Goofy by Livingston playwright Eric Alter, opens October 9 and plays for three weekends throught October 25. The story is simple on the surface. Two best friends, inseparable at thirteen, haven’t spoken in thirty years. One of them never left his childhood bedroom. His mother never left because someone had to take care of him. Then the other one comes back to town, and everyone in that house has been keeping the same secret. It’s a play about the things we never say to the people closest to us, and it sends people out the door talking. Please note the play deals with difficult subject matter and is recommended for ages 15 and up. The full synopsis and content advisory plus more information are at https://apricotskyproductions.com/killgoofy. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Oct 21, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Lunatic Fringe Improv Comedy Show 30th Season Opener! — Sat Oct 10, 8:00 PM — Glen Ridge Train Station (Community Center)
item.description:
Lunatic Fringe, New Jersey’s longest running improv troupe, launches its 30th season with a show at the Glen Ridge Train Station (Community Center) at 8 p.m. on October 10th. It’s not deep. It’s rarely thought-provoking. It’s just funny! The group uses music and audience suggestions to create a show that’s different every time, but always funny – and always apolitical! Lunatic Fringe performers include Director Deb Maclean, Paul Murphy, Dave Groveman, and Gary Van Lieu. Ben Rausch improvises on piano. The show is suitable for older children, and you are welcome to bring your own refreshments. Tickets are still only $12 at the door, but with a reservation, admission is only $10. Cash only. For reservations, CALL (973) 429-1527. (Texting not possible.) item.title: Weekend Warrior Tennis (Sundays) — Sun Oct 18, 9:00 AM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More Join us for friendly and sociable free rallies and possibly some informal matches for training and fun. We are beginner to intermediate levels but all are welcome. We don’t allow formal instruction on our group-reserved courts, although giving some quick tips is OK so long as you’re not holding up others waiting to play.
⛑️ **Clinic Matches:** If we have to rotate people in then we may play some clinic-style matches where everyone rotates in evenly. There is no holding the court via wins so everyone has a chance to play regardless of skill level.
🕊️ **Early Bird Start:** If you want to meet earlier than 9 AM (like 8 or 8:30) then please let us know by the day before and we’ll see who can join you (usually I can do earlier).
**🎾 Equipment:** Please bring your own racquet and water, as we don’t provide those. I always have some balls for at least one court, but feel free to bring your own in case we need to branch out over more than one

item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 minutes) — Mon Oct 19, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Awakening Awareness: Embracing This Moment — Tue Oct 20, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream Feel free to join as we get still and practise presence within this moment. We will discuss and observe the obstacles that, seemingly, block us from being present and bring awareness to our unconsciousness in a safe, inclusive and affirming way.
Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teaching and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous.
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys has been passionate about mindfulness since 2010 and since 2021 he has been organising free, weekly online meditation groups. For more information on his free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group, visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/).
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream
